 "data": "erDiagram
 USER {
 int id PK
 string username
 string email
 string password
 }
 VIDEO {
 int id PK
 string title
 text description
 string video_file
 boolean is_premium
 int views_count
 datetime created_at
 }
 
 SUBSCRIPTION {
 int id PK
 int user_id FK
 datetime start_date
 datetime end_date
 boolean is_active
 }
 PAYMENT {
 int id PK
 int user_id FK
 int subscription_id FK
 decimal amount
 string status
 datetime created_at
 }

 WATCH_HISTORY {
 int id PK
 int user_id FK
 int video_id FK
 datetime watched_at
 }
 COMMENT {
 int id PK
 int user_id FK
 int video_id FK
 text content
 datetime created_at
 }
 RATING {
 int id PK
 int user_id FK
 int video_id FK
 int score
 }

 USER ||--o{ SUBSCRIPTION : \"has\"
 USER ||--o{ PAYMENT : \"makes\"
 SUBSCRIPTION ||--o{ PAYMENT : \"generates\"

 USER ||--o{ COMMENT : \"writes\"
 VIDEO ||--o{ COMMENT : \"has\"
 
 USER ||--o{ RATING : \"rates\"
 VIDEO ||--o{ RATING : \"receives\"",
